inputs.text: This looks deliberate: the delay over renegotiating the 2009 agreement keeps SSANU weakened, while the government lets the dispute fester and then points to the one-month ultimatum as the problem. The blame is being redirected onto workers so the people prolonging the standoff can evade scrutiny. This isn’t about resolving the dispute—it’s about managing pressure and discrediting the union.

output.main_topic: Allegation that the government is using the delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement to weaken SSANU and redirect blame
subtopics: The government’s handling of the dispute
Alleged pressure management and union discrediting
